title: Project Body Neutrality - Evaluation of a culture-specific digital brief intervention to improve body image in adolescents with and without eating disorders
summary: In the present study, participants (adolescents from the general population, adolescent participants with anorexia nervosa and adolescents with other mental disorders and high body dissatisfaction) take part in the German adaptation of a digital single-session intervention on the topic of body neutrality called “Project Body Neutrality”. The German version of this intervention is to be evaluated for the first time. Single-session interventions are low-threshold interventions that consist of a single session. The intervention is conducted digitally and consists of psychoeducational elements on body neutrality and the effects that body image can have on mood, as well as exercises in which the newly acquired knowledge can be applied.
conditions: In addition to young people from the general population, adolescents with anorexia nervosa (F50.00, F50.01, F50.1) or other mental illnesses and high body dissatisfaction

interventions.name: Digital single-session intervention on body neutrality called “Project Body Neutrality”

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Applies only to the clinical subsample: n = 20 adolescent female patients (age 13;0 - 17;11 years) with anorexia nervosa or atypical anorexia nervosa (diagnosis according to ICD-10) and n = 20 other adolescents with other mental disorders and high body dissatisfaction (in the clinical impression and in the EDI-2 subscale “body dissatisfaction” (PR ≥ 85)) are planned.
Exclusion criteria:
Exclusion will take place in the event of insufficient knowledge of the German language. 
Only applies to the clinical subsample: Exclusion - due to known cognitive impairments - in the case of severe underweight (< 3rd BMI age percentile), an additional diagnosis of active psychosis, use of heavily sedating medication or insufficient knowledge of the German language.
